statement: A no-egress control that exercises multiple DNS, socket, HTTP, and process surfaces must bound each surface independently. A successful container network boundary does not prevent a newly uncovered or malfunctioning runtime-hook surface from hanging the entire probe and consuming a one-shot authorization. Accept only the hook's explicit denial; treat a timeout, unexpected success, or different error as fail-closed with the named surface. Prove compliant denial, timeout, and leak paths synthetically before binding the probe to any calibration execution.
quarantineReason: This staging record accompanies the timeout repair branch, whose eventual squash commit does not yet exist on Cejel origin/main. It must not anchor to its own branch.
moveCondition: After the timeout-repair PR merges, identify its 40-character squash commit on Cejel origin/main and verify that its diff adds the bounded per-surface probe helper and synthetic compliant-denial, hung-surface, and leaky-surface tests. Then copy this record into Alfred docs/orchestration/maeve-lesson-batches/ as a cejel_ batch with that commit, PR number, evidencePath, and evidenceQuote.
